habitat_summary: Pelagic fish in moderately cold coastal waters.
temperature_note: Peru field seasonal temperatures: 14-18 C in winter and 16-23 C in summer; observations, not thermal limits or optimum.
season_note: Spawning occurs nearly year-round, strongest in August-September and February-March.
el_nino_response_note: IMARPE reports distribution changes during warm 2023 conditions in the northern Humboldt Current region.
peru_coast_range_note: Northern Humboldt Current region of Peru.
fishery_note: Industrial and artisanal fisheries are reported.

habitat_summary: Neritic to oceanic; epipelagic to mesopelagic. Two tagged animals moved from near-surface to deep daytime waters.
temperature_note: Peru observations span about 14 C at 50 m to 27.5 C at sea surface; different depths, not thermal limits.
season_note: IMARPE reports main spawning from October to January and secondary activity in August.
el_nino_response_note: IMARPE survey reports a negative El Nino effect; 2018 bilingual abstracts differ in depth wording.
peru_coast_range_note: Peru, 10 to more than 500 nautical miles offshore.
fishery_note: IMARPE reports artisanal and industrial fleets.
notes: Two tagged squid reached 1200 m (2017, p. 174); this is not a population limit.

habitat_summary: Benthic in semi-protected bays on sedimentary bottoms; also sandy or muddy bottoms with shells and macroalgae.
temperature_note: Lab juveniles were tested at 17 and 22 C in Peru; treatment temperatures, not limits or optimum.
season_note: Spawning occurs year-round, stronger September to May.
el_nino_response_note: An IMARPE 2024 assessment reports poor population condition after the 2023-24 warm event despite expected density increase.
notes: Section 2.7.2 reports typical 5-40 m; IMARPE species record gives a broader intertidal-to-95 m distribution.

habitat_summary: Rocky intertidal and subtidal habitat; shelters in crevices and beneath rocks.
temperature_note: Field seasonal sea-surface averages in Ancash, Peru (2014-2023): 18.5-21.7 C; not thermal limits or optimum.
season_note: Spawning occurs year-round, with spring and summer peaks.
el_nino_response_note: IMARPE diet observations during 1982-83 and 1997-98 El Nino differed by site; no coast-wide response inferred.
notes: Species record gives intertidal to 30 m.

habitat_summary: Benthodemersal; IMARPE assessment reports concentrations at 100-200 m.
temperature_note: Peru field bottom temperatures: 10-16 C on normal cruise and 14.5-22.3 C during El Nino; not limits or optimum.
el_nino_response_note: IMARPE reports inverted distribution and 14.5-22.3 C bottom temperatures in the 1983 El Nino cruise.
notes: WoRMS accepts Merluccius peruanus; Merluccius gayi peruanus is retained as historical synonym.

habitat_summary: Pelagic-neritic fish in warm-temperate coastal waters over sandy or muddy bottoms.
season_note: Higher reproductive activity and landings occur in spring and summer.
el_nino_response_note: IMARPE reports higher cachema catches in Ancash and Lima during the 1997-98 El Nino; historical observation.
peru_coast_range_note: Peruvian coastal waters; source describes a northern-central Peru fishery.
fishery_note: Coastal fishery; landings reported from artisanal monitoring and PRODUCE records.
notes: No unambiguous min/max/optimum source found; temperature fields remain blank.
